notes.title: Cloud Save
notes.content:
Greetings, friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685303/bf8fe7e9aa67cdf354370085fedd4641dbda7485.png[/img]

We're excited to announce a new update that brings Cloud Saves to all the Frontline games.
All save files will be stored by Steam, meaning your progress will be safe and sound even if you reinstall the game.

We also understand that sometimes a fresh start is necessary. The option to reset your game progress is found in the Main Menu. Simply head to Options, then Profile, and hit Reset Profile if needed (this will reset all games progreess - a clean start if you will)

Thank you all for your patience and support. We hope this update adds a new level of convenience to your gaming experience. Happy gaming!

I'll be honest with you, this was my blunder believing it's too complicated for a non coder such as miself to implement. I could have implemented Cloud saved from day one but I just did not had the confidence. By bad, friends!
